name: shipflow
description: Drive ShipFlow from Codex: project status, issues, PRs, releases and loop mode via the bundled renaiss-shipflow CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Issues, PRs and loop mode via renaiss-shipflow
interface.longDescription: Adds the shipflow and smart-commit skills so Codex can check ShipFlow status, pick and claim issues, attach evidence, open and merge PRs, cut releases and run the autonomous issue-to-PR loop. Bundles the renaiss-shipflow CLI.
defaultPrompt: Use $shipflow to show my ShipFlow status
Use $shipflow to pick the next issue to work on
